name: Drone Assembly Plant
summary:
Experience the power of modern industrial automation in this immersive VR simulation. Witness the precise, step-by-step assembly of an advanced VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) drone on a fully automated, moving production line. Designed for robotics enthusiasts, engineers, and tech tech-heads, this experience puts you front and center of a next-generation manufacturing ecosystem.

With a simple start/stop interface, you can control the line and closely observe how complex machinery coordinates to build
